WITH station_level AS (
  SELECT 
    t.observstation,
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage
),
phase_level AS (
  SELECT 
    sl.lunarstage,
    AVG(sl.avg_bandwidth) as avg_of_avgs,
    SUM(sl.record_count) as sum_of_counts
  FROM station_level sl
  GROUP BY sl.lunarstage
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(pl.sum_of_counts) as total FROM phase_level pl
)
SELECT 
  pl.lunarstage as moon_phase,
  pl.avg_of_avgs,
  pl.sum_of_counts,
  CASE WHEN tc.total IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(pl.sum_of_counts AS REAL) / tc.total END as ratio
FROM phase_level pl
CROSS JOIN total_count tc
WHERE tc.total IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pl.lunarstage
